product.overview: Allow users of PQueue to change its rate-limit configuration at runtime on an existing queue instance.

requirements.text: An existing PQueue instance exposes a public writable intervalCap property. Setting it changes the cap used to schedule queued tasks without recreating the queue.
An existing PQueue instance exposes a public writable interval property. Setting it changes the time interval used to schedule queued tasks without recreating the queue.

reviewNotes: Requirements paraphrase issue #177. Expectations were independently reviewed from the base source and PR diff: the base has private readonly fields; the head adds intervalCap getter/setter and scheduling integration but no public interval setter. Expected statuses are evaluator data, never model input. PR status is not implementation evidence.
